_note: Real one-time backfill built 2026-08-18 from SiteLink Mgmt InquiryTracking + Unit MoveInsAndMoveOuts exports (Maitland + Salt River only - no CBD file was provided, so CBD has no backfill and stays blank for these months, as before). leads_placed = count of Inquiry Tracking rows by dPlaced month (raw row count, no genuine/junk filtering, matching the live pipeline's own no-manual-overlay rule). moveins/moveouts/transfers = Unit MoveInsAndMoveOuts rows flagged accordingly, by MoveDate month. cancelled = Inquiry Tracking rows by dCancelled month. leases_signed = same count as moveins for that month: the export has no distinct 'date lease was signed' field, and every completed move-in in this data represents an executed lease, so moveins is used as the direct proxy rather than inventing a different number.
